## 4. Web.config Files (IIS Rewrite Rules Only)

Two identical `web.config` files exist — these are **not ASP.NET configuration** but rather **IIS URL Rewrite** rules for hosting the Nuxt-generated static site on IIS.

### File 1: `G:\VUEJS-NEW\pro-vue-01\.output\public\web.config`
### File 2: `G:\VUEJS-NEW\pro-vue-01\public\web.config`

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<configuration>
  <system.webServer>
    <rewrite>
      <rules>
        <rule name="Nuxt static fallback" stopProcessing="true">
          <match url=".*" />
          <conditions logicalGrouping="MatchAll">
            <add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsFile" negate="true" />
            <add input="{REQUEST_FILENAME}" matchType="IsDirectory" negate="true" />
          </conditions>
          <action type="Rewrite" url="/index.html" />
        </rule>
      </rules>
    </rewrite>
  </system.webServer>
</configuration>
```

**Purpose:** When a file or directory is not found on IIS, it rewrites all requests to `/index.html` (SPA fallback for client-side routing). This is the standard Nuxt static deployment pattern on IIS.

Despite being a Nuxt/Vue project (not ASP.NET), the source is still organized into clear layers:

| Layer | Directory | Purpose |

| **Presentation** | `src/layouts/` | Main layout wrapper |
| **Routing** | `pages/` | Nuxt file-based router (auto-generated routes) |
| **Data Flow** | `src/stores/` | Pinia stores (state management) |
| **Business Logic** | `src/services/` | API service layer (newsService, categoryService, authService) |
| **Data Access** | `src/api/` | HTTP client (httpClient.js via Axios) |
| **Data** | `src/data/` | Static mock data (categories.js, news.js) |

| **Config** | `.env.example` | Environment variables |
| **Utilities** | `src/utils/` | Helpers (SEO, slug, date, sanitize, error handling) |

The **runtime flow** (from `PROJECT_DEV_GUIDE.html`) is:
```
URL → middleware → App.vue → MainLayout → pages/*.vue → src/pages/*View.vue → store → service → API
```

## Key Takeaway

**This is NOT an ASP.NET WebForms or MVC project.** It is a **Nuxt 3 (Vue 3) JavaScript project** — a modern static site generator / SSR framework running on Node.js. The `web.config` files are purely for IIS URL rewriting when hosting the compiled static output. The system rules registered for ASP.NET WebForms/C# do **not apply** to this codebase.
